title: eugenia costata
intro: Eugenia costata, commonly known as Brazilian guava, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Brazil. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory health benefits, making it useful for reducing oxidative stress and alleviating symptoms of arthritis and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Eugenia costata are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial, antifungal, and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
